summary_en: A brick robot snaps three bricks into a gapped toy bridge so a red brick car can drive across, in a Blender EEVEE tabletop scene.
limits_en: No 2x supersampling (32 TAA samples used to keep render time down); fine stud edges may shimmer slightly when viewed small.
The robot places bricks with position constraints and no finger grip; the bridge rebound under the car is tiny (about 0.5 mm).
Captions use Arial Rounded instead of the upstream-suggested Fredoka, which is not installed locally.
